correctness.rationale: The source Voronoi cell inequality in dimension 1 with X=[0,1], p1=0, p2=1 is g2(x)=x-1/2<=0, so V1=[0,1/2], relint V1=(0,1/2). The auxiliary LP min tau with x in X and g2(x)<=tau has unique minimizer x*=0,tau*=-1/2<0, yet x*=0 is NOT relatively interior. For p2, g1(x)=1/2-x gives unique x*=1 with the same negative slack, again not relative interior of [1/2,1]. The hypotheses X compact convex full-dimensional and distinct centers are satisfied; no objective or algorithmic convergence assumptions are needed. This exactly contradicts Proposition 1 in the version of Khademi whose problem (5) and proof were inspected. Negative slack certifies only strict Voronoi bisector inequalities, not a positive distance to boundary of X. Independent rational check directly replicates both LPs.
residual_risks: Finite checks only corroborate the identified closed proof steps and do not constitute infinite verification.
